title: Interpretability Analysis of End-to-End Learned CSI Feedback for Precoding-Oriented Massive MIMO
summary: An interpretability analysis of an end-to-end learned massive-MIMO system found that pilot and precoding representations changed with the feedback budget in simulated channels. This describes the evaluated model and does not establish behavior on hardware.
ai_technology: End-to-end learned channel-state feedback and precoding network
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: The study analyzed learned representations across feedback budgets and compared simulated-channel behavior with idealized bounds. The reported pilot and precoding changes were observed within the evaluated massive-MIMO simulation.
evidence.unknown: No radio-frequency hardware trial is reported; applicability beyond the modeled channel and system is unknown.
evidence.ai_role: A jointly trained neural network learned pilot signals, compressed channel feedback and downlink precoding.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
